name: Modbus TCP
description: Read and write Modbus TCP registers on PLCs, gateways and remote IO couplers. Devices are configured and connected right in the workbench, with polling and guarded writes.
releaseNotes: Initial release: Modbus TCP connection provider, register grid workbench with periodic polling, byte order and data type decoding, and guarded writes.

zh-CN.name: Modbus TCP
zh-CN.description: 读写 PLC、网关和远程 IO 上的 Modbus TCP 寄存器，支持周期轮询与带二次确认的写入。
